name: SideNavigationLink
description: Link to a top-level page. Set `current` on the link for the page the user is on. Renders an `<a>` element.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the link as the current page, applying the current style and setting `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the link, blocking all interactions. Removes `href` and sets `aria-disabled` on the `<a>` element. Takes precedence over `disabled` on `SideNavigation.Root`, and over `current` in how the link looks.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: SideNavigation.Link.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
